en.tagline: Surf weeks for all levels on Sri Lanka's south coast, a few steps from the ocean.
en.closing: Book the week for your level. Not sure which one fits? Ask us on WhatsApp first.
en.featureLine: Footwear is discouraged. Chilling out is inescapable.

copyBlocks.heading: Next set is yours
copyBlocks.body:
We are surfing obsessed, and we invite you to join us.

The lodge sits in the green of the jungle. We run surf weeks for three levels, from your first wave to carving, and a Freestylers package for independent travellers.

copyBlocks.heading: Surf, breakfast, surf again
copyBlocks.body:
Head out with your group for a morning surf. Back at the lodge, a big, healthy breakfast is waiting.

After that the day is yours: relax at the lodge, or go out and explore before the afternoon surf. The evening ends with dinner, together with the other guests.

copyBlocks.heading: Pick your level
copyBlocks.body:
Level 1 – Fomies is for your first time on a board, no surfing experience needed. You learn on soft boards, on easy reef breaks and the sandy beaches around the lodge.

Level 2 – Rollers is for when you can stand up, but paddling out to the line-up and catching green waves is still a struggle. You surf easy reefs and beach breaks with deep-water channels, on soft boards.

Level 3 – Riders: you're already carving, and you want to sharpen your skills. From Galle to Matara, you surf the best spot of the day for the conditions, the wind and the tide.

Freestylers is the package for independent travellers who want to soak up the lodge's vibe.

copyBlocks.heading: One price, three levels
copyBlocks.body:
The three surf weeks cost the same, per person for seven nights. That is the base price the booking engine showed on 28 September 2026. The room you choose can add to it; the engine shows any supplement once you pick your dates.

Packages start on a Saturday and run for 7, 14, 21 or 28 nights, for up to six guests per booking. Drinking water and local coffee and tea are unlimited.

copyBlocks.heading: Twelve rooms, one big family
copyBlocks.body:
There are just twelve rooms. That keeps a stay here personal, part of one big happy family. Every room has air conditioning, a ceiling fan, a safe box, a private toilet and shower, a socket next to each bed and, of course, a board rack.

When you're not on the water, lie out on a sunbed by the pool under the palms, hang out in the common area, take an ice-cold drink from the bar, or eat Sri Lankan produce from the lodge kitchen.

copyBlocks.heading: What guests say
copyBlocks.body:
Booking.com guests score the staff 9.5 out of 10, and the facilities and the cleanliness 9.2 each.

In their reviews they write about the pool area, the open-air bathroom and the breakfast bowls.

copyBlocks.heading: Getting here
copyBlocks.body: Booking.com puts Kathaluwa West Beach 40 m from the lodge and Kabalana Beach 350 m. Kathaluwa station is 400 m away, Ahangama Beach 4 km and Koggala Airport 3.9 km.

testimonials.quote: We loved the cozy, bohoo-vibes at the lodge: starting from the open-air-bathroom, the relaxing pool area and especially the great breakfast bowls!
testimonials.author: Fanny, Germany

testimonials.quote: This place felt like something inbetween a hostel and a luxurious hotel. The styling was gorgeous, the beds very comfortable, the (bath)room very spacious with lockers and personal storage space.
testimonials.author: Myrthe, Netherlands

testimonials.quote: A lovely hotel and a team of champions. Ariel, a professional surf guide, raised the level of surfing for us by several steps during the week we were there. This is our second time at the same hotel and with the same guide. We will return next year as well
testimonials.author: Seagallas

testimonials.quote: The room was modern, quiet and incredibly clean with daily servicing. The grounds were well kept with a gorgeous pool and dining area. There are hammocks, loungers and beanbags in social areas. It was a really really great place.
testimonials.author: Abigail, Myanmar

testimonials.quote: I had a wonderful stay at this hostel in Kabalana. The place was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming.
testimonials.author: Maryam, Netherlands

testimonials.quote: We stayed at Global Kablana Sri Lanka as a couple and two girls and it was just fun and lovely. The atmosphere, the rooms, the stunning staff. Just everything.
testimonials.author: Dana Amsalem-Cohen

testimonials.quote: The common areas and the rooms are really nice! Staff is very helpful and the breakfast options are awesome.
testimonials.author: Agustin, Chile

testimonials.quote: Super nice place, beautiful rooms, nice hangout area with pool and pillows and delicious breakfast!
testimonials.author: Sara, Austria

testimonials.quote: The staff were lovely and welcoming. The property itself was clean and comfortable.
testimonials.author: Hannah, Oman

en.spot: The lodge overlooks two spots, The Rock and South Point. More waves are a few minutes away by tuk-tuk.
